column1: # The BriefAgent runtime's container images — the single source of truth.
# Tab-separated, one image per line:
#   <our name>  <upstream ref>  <upstream digest>  <kind>  <role>
# `kind` is `mirror` (the upstream bytes are copied into our registry unchanged)
# or `build` (we build the image ourselves from pinned upstream source, under
# build/<name>/). scripts/mirror.sh acts on `mirror` rows, scripts/build.sh on
# `build` rows.
# Every upstream ref is pinned by DIGEST. A tag is mutable: the runner's own
# policy defaults are tags, and their comment concedes the CLI "cannot know
# digest values ahead of time" (agentry-cli/pkg/runner/policy/policy.go:33).
# Here we can, so we do. Re-resolve with scripts/pin.sh, which prints a diff
# and never edits this file silently.
# A tab-separated file rather than YAML on purpose: this is a supply-chain
# manifest, and the script that reads it should be auditable without a parser.
# Scope: the RUNTIME plane only. The SecureAgentry application's images
# (postgres, minio, redis, the edge, authentik, opensearch, secureagentryd)
# are not here — they belong to the application's compose stack and helm chart.
agentry-mcp-gateway
column5: the tool plane: Docker's MCP gateway, started once per run with --block-network (policy images.gateway)

column1: agentry-docker-agent
column5: the default harness, the agent program that talks to the model (policy images.harnessDockerAgent); build/docker-agent/ is the from-source replacement, not yet the published image

column1: agentry-golang-alpine
column5: builds the local runner image: the GO_IMAGE build-arg of runnerimage/Dockerfile (policy images.goBuilder)

column1: agentry-alpine
column5: the runner image's runtime base: the FROM of runnerimage/Dockerfile's second stage

column1: agentry-node-alpine
column5: installs and runs a BriefAgent's declared npm MCP servers (policy images.nodeRuntime)

column1: agentry-python-alpine
column5: installs and runs a BriefAgent's declared PyPI MCP servers (policy images.pythonRuntime)

column1: # Build-time dependencies: not pulled by a run, needed only to build an image
# in build/. Kept in the same manifest so every ref this repository touches is
# pinned in one place.
agentry-mcp-gateway-v2
column5: build-time only: upstream's docker-agent Dockerfile copies the /docker-mcp CLI plugin out of this floating v2 tag; we copy it out of a digest instead
